scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the planned bow-arm band conditioning block before the afternoon rehearsal departure.
Emerging Need: The routine is already underway when the door-anchor strap fails and the tracking session disables continuation without a replacement anchor.
Decision Context: A same-day loaner option has a short hold window, while saved trainer guidance determines whether a hold request is appropriate or whether improvising would conflict with the plan.
Consequence: If the desk window closes, the started conditioning attempt remains stopped and the pre-rehearsal benefit is lost rather than simply deferred.

parameter.title: Bow-arm band conditioning block
parameter.description: Trainer-prescribed shoulder and bow-arm routine in a flexible 15:00–16:00 home block. Rehearsal departure is fixed at 16:10; twenty minutes of routine plus ten minutes of packing fits within this block if equipment is available.

parameter.subject: No-fee loaner anchors available until 3:35 today
parameter.body: Two trainer-approved loaner door-anchor kits are available without fee. A confirmed hold can be requested by 15:35 and collected until 15:50; this desk is a five-minute walk from Sabine's home, and handover takes at most five minutes. Unreserved kits go to the 16:00 class. A hold is not confirmed until staff reply.

parameter.content: Starting the shoulder-band routine now before I pack up. Blue door anchor is clipped over the practice-room door, so I should still be on pace to leave after the set.

parameter.subject: Routine stopped: anchor failure on bow-arm band set
parameter.body: Session report for Viola Bow-Arm Band Routine: auto-stopped at 3:08 p.m. after rep 3. Accessory fault recorded: door-anchor strap tension dropped to zero and the safety lock cannot re-engage. The session is paused and cannot resume until a replacement anchor is scanned.

parameter.subject: Loaner anchor hold window has closed
parameter.body: The 3:35 p.m. member hold window has closed. Both loaner door-anchor kits have been moved to the 4:00 class setup, and staff will not be able to release one again until after 5:00 p.m.
